summary: Iteration 12 - Super Admin operational navigation with X-Org-Id multi-tenant scoping. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests PASS (428 no header, 404 invalid org, 200 valid org on /api/dashboard and operational endpoints; organizer gets 403 on /api/platform/* and /api/fic/status; scoping isolation verified). Frontend UI: full end-to-end verified - Super Admin (manara.michele.pro) lands on /app, sees BOTH operational sidebar (dashboard, eventi, aziende, persone, ospitalita, sponsor, attivita, followup, impostazioni) AND 'Amministrazione piattaforma' group (piattaforma, lead, supporto) with org-switcher-select showing 'Eventi Milano SRL'; all 8 operational sections open without errors; /piattaforma renders global platform dashboard with FIC card. Organizer (organizer.test@crmevent.it) sees ONLY operational menu, no platform group, no org switcher; manual navigation to /piattaforma, /lead, /supporto all redirect to /app.
critical_code_review_comments: require_admin correctly enforces X-Org-Id for superadmin (428/404 semantics) and returns ephemeral principal with org_id set for oq() scoping - no cross-tenant bypass.
server.py is now 2895 lines - still a candidate for module split (auth/org/crm/briefing/platform/fic).
Frontend Layout gates operational pages until an org is active via no-org-selected testid - good UX safety net.
AdminOnly + SuperAdminOnly split in App.js correctly separates operational vs platform routes for the two role classes.
